newsitem.title: FRANCE: Pau-Pyrenees freight and mail traffic declines.
newsitem.headline: Pau-Pyrenees freight and mail traffic declines.

text.p: Airfreight handled at Pau-Pyrenees Airport totalled 995 tonnes in the first ten months of 1996, down 2.6 percent on the same period last year, airport authority figures showed.
Air France Europe generates the major part of cargo traffic handled at Pau Airport while other airline operators include fellow French carriers, Air Littoral and Regional Airlines.
January-October postal traffic handled at Nice Airport in the first ten months of the year declined by 10.2 percent on 1995 levels at 1,007 tonnes.
French airline, L'Aeropostale, carries overnight mail to
and from Pau on a regular basis, using 4.5 tonne- capacity Fokker 27 aircraft. -- Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
